context: A teacher gives a uni student writing-method feedback
purpose: Teach: 英文/解答/検定/検出/限度/欠点/ユニーク/多々

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮くん、先週提出してくれた英文ライティングの解答用紙、目を通しましたよ。
lines.en: Ren, I've looked through the English writing assignment you submitted last week.
lines.style: Warm but composed teacher tone, opening feedback gently with formal politeness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。正直、英検の検定対策を意識して書いたんですけど、自信がなくて…。
lines.en: Thank you. Honestly, I wrote it with the Eiken certification test in mind, but I'm not confident.
lines.style: Nervous university student, slightly humble, seeking reassurance from teacher.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 発想自体はとてもユニークで、面白い視点が多々ありました。そこは大きな強みです。
lines.en: The ideas themselves were very unique, and there were many interesting perspectives. That's a real strength.
lines.style: Encouraging, leading with praise before constructive criticism, professional warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本当ですか?嬉しいです。でも、欠点もきっとありますよね…遠慮なく指摘してください。
lines.en: Really? I'm glad. But there must be weak points too, right? Please point them out honestly.
lines.style: Eager student humbly inviting criticism, mature self-aware attitude toward growth.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうですね、一文が少し長すぎて、読み手の集中力の限度を超えてしまう箇所が見受けられました。
lines.en: Well, some sentences were a bit too long, and there were places that exceeded the reader's concentration limit.
lines.style: Specific, diagnostic feedback delivered with measured academic warmth and care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど、確かに書きながら止まれなくなる癖があって…。
lines.en: I see, certainly I have a habit of not being able to stop while writing.
lines.style: Reflective acknowledgment, casual trailing speech showing genuine self-recognition of flaws.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: それと、同じ単語の繰り返しも検出できたので、類義語に置き換えるともっと洗練されますよ。
lines.en: Also, I detected repetition of the same words, so replacing them with synonyms will make it more refined.
lines.style: Additional concrete feedback offered as constructive next step with gentle expertise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、必ず直してきます。今日のフィードバック、本当にありがとうございました!
lines.en: Yes, I'll definitely correct it. Thank you so much for today's feedback!
lines.style: Energetic grateful closing, motivated student tone with renewed determination.
